dct_title_s: Map of Martinez & vicinity : Contra Costa Co. California
dct_description_sm: compiled by R.R. Arnold, county surveyor.
Compass rose with north oriented at upper left.
Cadastral map showing lots, ownership (personal, city, and corporate (Shell, General Chemical)).
Handwritten and colored notes, dividing lines.
